'''Lickflicker''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Sizzribb]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Ignitoad]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "'Lickflickers learn about the world by putting things in their mouths, so keep a close eye on your food, gloves, and valuables-especially anything sensitive to heat.' -Tatari Observation Diary"

Lickflicker is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
An orange and red frog/toad with a white underside and yellow eyes. Its has dark brown, horizontal slit pupils and 3 red teardrop shaped crests on its chest. It also has flames around its arms and behind its eyes.

Lickflicker's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its eyes, chest crests, and flames to blue.

== Evolution Trial ==
Lickflicker's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Ignitoad]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Use Energy Drink x20,000.
* Feed Lickflicker 15 Volcano Pizzas.

== Trivia ==
* Lickflicker and its evolutions were added to the game on 07/15/2026 alongside [[Hychroma]] and [[Ecstamira]].
